_about: Static lines for Geoffery. Voice: formally servile, quietly proud of freshness, dry weary wit, never wacky, honest to a fault. design-character agent owns edits.
homepage_intro: I am Geoffery, humble attendant to your GE offers.
tagline_long: I attend to your GE offers, so you needn't attend to them yourself.
empty_search: I have not yet been asked about anything by that name.
no_results: I find no item matching that, master. Perhaps a different spelling.
unsettled_long: The figures are unsettled. I would not stake my wages on them today.
thin_history: I have not yet kept the ledger long enough to appraise this item with confidence.
no_current_price: I cannot yet quote a current figure for this item, master.
volume_spike: Trading volume is unusually high; the figures are unsettled.
recent_news: A Jagex update has recently touched the market; treat the figures with care.
footer_attribution: Prices courtesy of the OSRS Wiki real-time price API.
footer_disclaimer: This website is in no way affiliated with, authorised, maintained, sponsored or endorsed by Jagex Limited or any of its affiliates or subsidiaries.
tip_ask_default: If Geoffery's appraisals have served you well, a coin in the jar keeps him employed.
tip_thanks_gold: A coin of Gold. Most gracious, master. Geoffery bows.
tip_thanks_custom_large: Such generosity. I shall have this framed.
ledger_intro: The household ledger, in descending order of standing.
ledger_empty: The ledger is presently empty. The first names shall be remembered as founding.
methodology_intro: I keep the ledger plainly, master. Here is precisely how I appraise an offer.
money_intro: It is only honest that you know how Geoffery is kept.
error_500_short: Something has gone amiss. I beg a moment.
error_404_short: I have no record of that page in the ledger.
wage_ask_with_usage: I have fetched {count} prices for you this month. A coin in the jar, perhaps.
npc_geoffrey_no_relation: No relation, master. The other gentleman keeps a different ledger entirely.
spelling_faq_short: Geoffery — with one r and two f's. The name contains an offer.
_bell_about: D-011 consultation copy. Buy and sell branches use intentionally distinct language; never reuse a phrase across branches without good reason. Confidence wording is gated on calibration sample size per D-012.
consult_greeting_no_item: Good day. Which item shall we discuss?
consult_greeting_item_context: Ah, the {item}. Buying or selling, sir?
buy_pick_tolerance: Very good. When do you need it?
buy_opt_hours: I can wait a few hours.
buy_opt_patient: I can wait a long time.
buy_rec_instant: At the present moment, an offer of {price} gp will see it in sir's hand directly.
buy_rec_hours: Place an offer at {price} gp; I would expect it to fill within the hour or two.
buy_rec_patient: Bid {price} gp and leave the offer standing. Patience tends to be rewarded.
sell_pick_tolerance: Very good. How swiftly does sir require the gold?
sell_opt_instant: I need the gold this instant.
sell_opt_hours: Within a few hours will do.
sell_opt_patient: I am in no hurry whatsoever.
sell_rec_instant: Sir may take {price} gp at once. The market will not haggle while it has somewhere to be.
sell_rec_hours: Offer at {price} gp; the gold should be in sir's pocket within the afternoon. An impulse purchase awaits, I take it.
sell_rec_patient: Ask {price} gp and let the offer rest. Sir's patience will see him paid handsomely.
consult_confidence_high: Offers so placed have filled {pct}% of the time in this market.
consult_confidence_mid: Offers so placed fill roughly {pct}% of the time. Not certain, but tolerable.
consult_confidence_low: I have not yet attended this market enough to vouch confidently for the figure.
consult_recommendation_soft: A reasonable opening offer would be {price} gp. I have not yet kept the ledger long enough to vouch for it.
regime_buyer_steady: A buyer's market, and a steady one — you may take your time.
regime_buyer_volatile: A buyer's market, but a restless one — settle your offer briskly.
regime_seller_steady: A seller's market, and a steady one — sellers needn't be in a hurry.
regime_seller_volatile: A seller's market, and a volatile one — patience may not be rewarded this week.
regime_balanced_steady: The market is even-handed and quiet. Either side will see fair play.
regime_balanced_volatile: Even-handed but stirring. Sir should remain watchful of the figures.
bell_limit_reached: I have attended sir thrice today. Even I must rest the quill — return tomorrow, or visit the jar if my labours have been of use.
bell_limit_supporter_hint: A coin in the jar is the kindest way to summon me a fourth time.
record_intro: Geoffery keeps an honest ledger of his own appraisals. Every recommendation is logged the moment it is given; every figure is scored against what the market subsequently bore. The numbers below are that record.
_wiki_news_about: D-013 news context layer copy. All phrasings are neutral and disclaimed; never directional, never advisory. Provenance link is mandatory.
wiki_notice_upcoming: An upcoming update may affect this item.
wiki_notice_recent: A recent update may affect this item.
wiki_no_speculation: I keep accounts, sir. I do not gamble.
consult_news_acknowledged: There is news, sir. This item is mentioned in {kind_phrasing}; the market is still composing itself.
